root_idea.summary: The root centers on undoing, unraveling, or breaking something that had been joined, bound, or established.
root_idea.development: Its physical image is the undoing of fibers, yarn, or rope; this develops into the figurative breaking of covenants and the reversal of an intended course. Other derivatives preserve passive, nominal, technical, and figurative branches.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I perfect citation form نَكَثَ.
Displayed under the supported singular lexical citation form نِكْثٌ; the Quran occurrence is its plural أَنْكَاثًا.

senses.definition: To break or violate a covenant, compact, oath, or pledged word.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of repudiating a previously made commitment; the commitment may be expressed as a covenant or oath or understood from context.

senses.definition: Untwisted strands or fibers: material undone from yarn, garments, or similar fabric and prepared to be spun again.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quran attests the plural أَنْكَاثًا in a simile involving yarn or fabric that has been unraveled.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To undo the threads of a garment or untwist a rope; more generally, to make fibers or material loose, disintegrated, or separate.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A physical Form I usage, extended from unraveling a woven or fibrous object to its becoming uncompacted or disunited.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To turn away from a matter or withdraw from an undertaking.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with عَنْ in the cited construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To mutually dissolve or break covenants or compacts.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal Form VI construction concerning commitments held by two or more parties.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become undone or untwisted, with fibers becoming uncompacted, disunited, or separated.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The intransitive Form VIII counterpart of physical unraveling, applied to garments, ropes, and fibrous objects.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become emaciated or lean after having been fat; the participle مُنْتَكِثٌ denotes one so emaciated.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The supplied attestations describe loss of condition after former fatness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a covenant, compact, or act of inauguration: to become dissolved, violated, or broken.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive Form VIII construction in which the commitment is treated as broken.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To turn from one desired or sought thing to another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the construction انتكث من حاجة إلى أخرى or لِأُخْرَى.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An undone or untwisted rope, especially at its end.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A concrete nominal use distinct from the Quranic plural referring to material prepared for re-spinning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Pustules appearing in the mouths of camels.
A disease affecting the two prominent bones beside a camel’s ears.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The affected structures are called النَّكَفَتَانِ; the disease is also called نُكَافٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Broken particles left at the end of a tooth-stick, or material undone or untwisted from the end of a rope.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun for small remnants or loosened material at an object’s end.

other_classical_meanings.definition: What has been undone or untwisted from a rope.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A substantive derived from the intransitive use of انْتَكَثَ for a rope.
A figurative nominal use synonymous with failure to keep a commitment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A difficult, arduous, or great affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative designation for a serious undertaking or situation, including one in which a group breaks its covenants.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The utmost effort, exertion, power, or strength.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of reaching the limit of one’s effort or strength.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Nature, natural disposition, temperament, or an inherent property.

other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An attributed figurative use, explained in relation to the weakening of one’s powers.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who undoes thread and twists it again.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intensive agent noun for repeated or characteristic unraveling and re-spinning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who habitually violates or breaks covenants or compacts.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative intensive agent noun applied to a persistent covenant-breaker.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Physical undoing of garments and ropes.
Fiber disintegration is covered by the broader physical sense.
Figurative breaking of covenants or compacts.
Pointer-only entry referring to Form VIII.
Separation of tooth-stick fibers is covered by the physical sense.
A covenant becoming broken or violated.
Turning from one sought thing to another.
Illustrative restatement of the re-spun material sense.
Disease affecting the bones beside a camel’s ears.
Untwisted rope-end material is grouped with the same remnants sense.
Great affair is grouped with the difficult or arduous affair sense.
Agent who repeatedly undoes and re-twists thread.
Participial form denoting emaciation or leanness.

cautions: The Quranic nominal occurrence is attested only as the plural أَنْكَاثًا; نِكْثٌ is used as the normalized lexical citation form.
